title: Paxton Partied in Dubai With Fugitives Charged With Fraud, Lawsuit Says
summary: Ken Paxton celebrated New Year’s Eve in 2024 with two men wanted on federal charges, one of whom donated at least $190,000 to his campaigns. The extent of his ties to the men was unclear.
